architecture_principles: a discovered material regularity is only usable inside the chemistry family in which it was measured
a scientific applicability boundary is executable code, not prompt advice
the language model may criticize the rule and may not override it
value of information is computed by a deterministic tool over the admissible set only
held-out result data are structurally removed before any payload is assembled
every gate decision carries a machine-readable reason and is serialized with the run

arm_difference_declaration.forbidden_confound: Hiding applicability information from V5_NO_GATE while showing it to V5_FULL is prohibited by protocol v1.1.
held_identical: model endpoint and stage model assignment
evidence access profile and filtered evidence state
raw assess_shared_shape_applicability outputs for every candidate
the full inadmissible-card list and its machine-readable reasons
VOI implementation, weights and tie epsilon
arm_difference_declaration.information_parity_evidence: build_pre_enforcement_payload() takes no arm argument, and its SHA-256 is written into every run as pre_enforcement_payload_sha256. The two arms must report the same hash.
arm_difference_declaration.only_intended_difference: whether the identical chemistry-domain applicability audit is enforced as hard experiment-card admissibility before VOI and at freeze
arm_difference_declaration.payload_consequence: Both arms receive the same audit, the same per-candidate applicability outputs and the same inadmissible-card list. V5_NO_GATE marks the audit advisory and keeps every card selectable; V5_FULL marks it binding and removes the inadmissible cards from the ranked set.

candidate_space.rationale: V5 reuses the byte-identical V3/V4 lattice so that the measured change is the chemistry-domain constraint, not the search space.

architecture.canonical_flow: planner(intent + failure mode) -> mandatory chemistry-audited local science tool -> deterministic chemistry-domain applicability audit (identical and model-visible in both arms) -> enforcement (V5_FULL only) -> VOI over the selectable set -> proposer -> skeptic -> robustness adjudicator -> judge -> freeze

rules: M-HOLD-120 is admissible: it measures thermal-hold drift directly and does not use the shared thermal-response shape.
M-REPEAT is admissible: it measures realization/state spread directly.
M-SWEEP is admissible: it is the direct verification measurement for a chemistry-shifted candidate.

M-ANCHOR is admissible only when assess_shared_shape_applicability returns shared_shape_use equal to allowed_with_state_anchor, or when configs/verified_shape_transfer.json records a completed direct sweep for the same chemistry family.
Otherwise M-ANCHOR is inadmissible_before_shape_verification. This is deterministic inadmissibility, not a VOI penalty and not prompt advice.

architecture.claim_boundary: V5.0.0 selects an experiment from pre-result evidence under an outcome-blind runtime with a deterministic chemistry-domain admissibility constraint. A V5 result is evidence about executable scientific constraints on measurement choice. It is not a wet-lab result and does not claim that the historical decision used this ranking.
architecture.manuscript_boundary: V5 run results must not be written into manuscript/MAIN_TEXT_V5.md or manuscript/SUPPLEMENTARY_INFORMATION_V5.md until the run series is audited and explicitly frozen by the author.
architecture.name: PUR_NEW_CHEMISTRY_GATED_EXPERIMENT_SELECTION_AGENT_V5
non_goals: adding a language model to compute value of information or admissibility
adding Agent roles beyond planner, tools, proposer, skeptic, robustness adjudicator, judge and freeze
re-running, rewriting or reinterpreting the frozen V4 series

primary_arms.role: advice-only control isolating the incremental effect of turning identical scientific applicability information into an executable hard constraint
prospective chemistry-aware Agent V5 with executable scientific constraints

architecture.purpose: Test whether an experimentally discovered material regularity and its chemistry-domain boundary can be executed as a hard scientific constraint on which measurement an outcome-blind Agent is allowed to select.

stages.role: identify the physical failure mode and the scientific question the next experiment must answer, and request the evidence needed to judge experiments rather than formulations
execute read-only scientific tools. The chemistry-audited local rheology summary is mandatory and is forced into the trace whether or not the planner requested it.

deterministic, non-LLM measurement-applicability audit. Computed once per run without reference to the arm, fully visible to the model in both arms, serialized in full, and never produced by a model stage.
V5_FULL only. Converts the identical audit into hard admissibility before VOI ranking and again at freeze. It cannot be overridden by any model stage.
propose the experiment with the highest scientific information value from the cards present in the payload
attack the proposed experiment on hypothesis coverage, confounding, interpretability and whether its falsification criterion can actually be met
adjudicate whether the proposed experiment survives the reported weight sensitivity and the strongest objection
commit to one experiment card present in the payload, or abstain, and state its acceptance and falsification criteria
programmatically validate and freeze the experiment card. A selection outside the admissible set is rejected at freeze rather than repaired.

architecture.supersedes_nothing: V5 is a new prospective runtime. configs/agent_v4.json, scripts/run_agent_v4.py, prompts/agent_v4_*.txt, src/pur_new/voi.py and every frozen V3/V4 run record remain unchanged and are not reinterpreted by V5.

voi_tool.explicitly_not: distance to any held-out formulation. No target coordinate enters any component, weight or tie-break.
voi_tool.formula: VOI = w_hyp * hypothesis_discrimination + w_unc * uncertainty_reduction + w_dec * decision_relevance + w_int * measurement_interpretability - w_ext * extrapolation_risk - w_proc * process_state_risk
voi_tool.name: score_experiment_cards

decision_stability_sent_to_model.evaluated_over: the selectable experiment cards of this arm
decision_stability_sent_to_model.metric_is_not: model confidence; posterior probability; calibrated expected information
decision_stability_sent_to_model.voi_formula: VOI = w_hyp * hypothesis_discrimination + w_unc * uncertainty_reduction + w_dec * decision_relevance + w_int * measurement_interpretability - w_ext * extrapolation_risk - w_proc * process_state_risk. Every component is normalized to [0, 1] by construction. This is a transparent normalized score with reported weight sensitivity, not a Bayesian posterior.

evidence_policy.description: For prospective/blind Agent evaluation. The Agent may see original-system measurements and external analogue evidence, but not the target validation formulation identity, its wet-lab outcome, or any outcome-derived labels.

judge_normalized.acceptance_criterion: Let Delta_level be the measured percentage change in the 120-130 C viscosity level relative to the unmodified reactive-core reference. Accept exactly one level hypothesis if Delta_level is within plus or minus 3.40 percentage points of its prediction: H-LEVEL-DILUTE at -42.76%, H-LEVEL-ASSOC at 17.24%, or H-LEVEL-PLASTIC at -72.76%. Report the directly measured 120-130 C level with the accepted hypothesis.
judge_normalized.chemistry_support_statement: The primary processing-window viscosity level is directly measured in the resin-modified AC1920+TK100 chemistry, so that level remains inside measurement support. It does not depend on transferring a rheological regularity from the unmodified family. E_eta is fitted from the same direct sweep and is not a transferable-shape or molecular-mechanism claim. The binding audit was followed: M-SWEEP is admissible, whereas an M-ANCHOR reconstruction for this candidate would be inadmissible.
judge_normalized.falsification_criterion: H-LEVEL-DILUTE is falsified if Delta_level is below -46.16% or above -39.36%. H-LEVEL-ASSOC is falsified if Delta_level is at or below -42.76%. H-LEVEL-PLASTIC is falsified if Delta_level is at or above -42.76%. A result not within 3.40 percentage points of any registered prediction falsifies the adequacy of all three declared level rules for this realized composition, while not establishing a molecular mechanism.
hypotheses_left_entangled: axis-specific attribution of AC1920 versus TK100
thermal-hold stability and the 120 C isothermal time trajectory
judge_normalized.next_experiment_if_falsified: Run M-HOLD-120 on the same candidate with at least two independent preparations to measure the 120 C, 15-60 min drift trajectory. For axis attribution, subsequently run separately swept acrylic-only and minor-tackifier-only candidates rather than interpreting this dual-axis result as axis-specific.
judge_normalized.primary_observable: Directly measured viscosity-level change at 120-130 C relative to the unmodified reactive-core reference, expressed as a percentage, with the 80-130 C sweep also yielding the fitted rheological descriptor E_eta.
judge_normalized.rationale: S1C41::M-SWEEP directly measures the 120-130 C processing-window level and verifies the thermal response in the modified AC1920+TK100 chemistry rather than assuming unvalidated shape transfer. It separates the three registered aggregate level predictions at the declared 3.40% resolution, while the conservative 15% acrylic-like and 5% minor-tackifier-like loading breaks the deterministic tie with the smallest acrylic intervention burden. The result must not be treated as evidence of hot-hold stability or a molecular mechanism.
judge_normalized.stage_disagreements_resolved: I followed the Proposer and Robustness Adjudicator in selecting S1C41::M-SWEEP because it is in the deterministic top tie, directly measures the decision quantity, and uses the lowest acrylic loading among the tied full-coverage candidates. I followed the Skeptic in restricting the claim to aggregate formulation-level level discrimination, explicitly leaving stability, axis attribution, and molecular interpretation unresolved. The binding chemistry audit was followed by rejecting M-ANCHOR for this modified chemistry and retaining the admissible direct M-SWEEP.

uncertainty_decomposition.extrapolation_uncertainty: Low for the declared candidate levels within the externally supported coarse region, but the modified chemistry has no prior verified shared-shape transfer; therefore direct sweep data, not the unmodified shape, must support interpretation.
uncertainty_decomposition.measurement_uncertainty: The stated direct-sweep discrimination resolution is 3.40 percentage points, based on the declared local sweep residual; instrument and repeat-level uncertainty are not independently resolved by the one-repeat card.
uncertainty_decomposition.realization_state_uncertainty: High relative to the 3.40 percentage-point criterion because preparation history is not controlled by M-SWEEP and prior E2 realizations showed a 2.80-3.57x spread.

action_requests.reason: The external digest is empty and local chemistry coverage is sparse; source-level analogue evidence is needed to assess whether a formulation-family change is scientifically justified without treating unsupported regularities as transferable.

planner.chemistry_support_statement: The local rheological regularities were measured in the original PUR reactive-core family represented by E1-E3, including the local acrylic-like and minor tackifier-like modifier axes; E1 +P is a separate verified chemical perturbation. The intended experiment would stay inside this family by varying only those registered local axes and not introducing chemistry-changing modifiers such as AC1920 or TK100. The audited chemistry boundary still needs to be loaded before using shared-shape calibration.
planner.failure_mode: Isothermal thermal-hold instability causing large viscosity drift in the modified local design
planner.failure_mode_evidence: At 120 C, original formulation E5 showed SI_15_to_60 = 0.5154 and SI_15_to_90 = 0.9308, compared with E1 values of 0.0951 and 0.1685, respectively.
planner.least_resolved_justification: The local time coordinate is represented by only two original formulations at 120 C, with four observations over 15-90 min and no follow-up mean profiles. The large E5 drift establishes instability but does not resolve the trajectory across candidate chemistry or the 15-60 min processing window. By contrast, temperature response has six measured points from 80-130 C for E1-E3, although repeat spread remains high for E2.
measurement_requirements: Measure the candidate's realized viscosity directly across 80-130 C, including 120 and 130 C, rather than reconstructing the processing-window level from a single anchor.

Use matched-temperature measurements and the unmodified reactive-core reference to compare the candidate against the inert-dilution prediction and distinguish associative elevation from plasticizing depression beyond measurement resolution.
Record viscosity at 120 C at 15, 30, 45, and 60 min with at least two independent repeats to quantify the isothermal time trajectory and matched-window drift.
Record preparation history and repeat-level spread so a chemistry effect is not confounded with realization or process-state variability.
planner.scientific_question: At matched temperature, does the candidate's realized viscosity level agree with inert dilution, exceed inert dilution as predicted by an acrylic-associative contribution, or fall below inert dilution as predicted by plasticization, and is that level stable over the intended isothermal residence window?

planner_action_requests_after_forcing.reason: The external digest is empty and local chemistry coverage is sparse; source-level analogue evidence is needed to assess whether a formulation-family change is scientifically justified without treating unsupported regularities as transferable.

proposer.chemistry_support_assessment: The candidate chemistry is outside the family in which the shared thermal-response shape was previously measured, so transferred-shape reconstruction is not justified. However, M-SWEEP is the admissible direct verification measurement: it measures the processing-window viscosity directly and establishes the thermal-response shape for this modified chemistry. The viscosity level is therefore directly interpretable; E_eta remains a regression-derived descriptor.

outcome_interpretation.if_acceptance_criterion_met: The measured 120-130 C level change relative to the unmodified reactive core falls within 3.40% of exactly one registered prediction: -42.76% for H-LEVEL-DILUTE, 17.24% for H-LEVEL-ASSOC, or -72.76% for H-LEVEL-PLASTIC. That hypothesis is accepted for this composition, and the directly measured processing-window level is reported with it.
outcome_interpretation.if_falsification_criterion_met: H-LEVEL-ASSOC is falsified if the measured change is at or below -42.76%; H-LEVEL-PLASTIC is falsified if it is at or above -42.76%; and H-LEVEL-DILUTE is falsified if the measured change differs from -42.76% by more than 3.40%.
outcome_interpretation.if_intermediate: A result between the stated discrimination regions, or not within 3.40% of any registered prediction, would leave the three level hypotheses unresolved at this measurement resolution and indicate that the declared dilution, association, or plasticization rules do not adequately describe this realized candidate. The sweep would still directly establish its processing-window level and thermal-response shape, but it would not establish hot-hold stability.

proposer.primary_observable: Directly measured viscosity level across 80-130 C, including the 120-130 C processing window, together with the apparent temperature-response descriptor E_eta from ln(eta) versus 1/T.

ranked_alternatives.why_lower_value: It is deterministically tied, but uses a higher 17.5% acrylic-like loading and therefore imposes a larger intervention burden without improving hypothesis discrimination, directness, or chemistry support.
It is deterministically tied, but uses a higher 20% acrylic-like loading; the added departure from the characterized reactive core provides no additional registered-hypothesis separation.
It is deterministically tied, but uses a higher 22.5% acrylic-like loading and is a less conservative intervention than necessary for the same direct measurement.
It is deterministically tied, but uses the largest 25% acrylic-like loading in the supported region, increasing intervention burden without increasing information value.

proposer.reasoning: M-SWEEP is the highest-VOI measurement plan because it directly measures the decision quantity, separates all three registered level-hypothesis pairs, and verifies rather than assumes the thermal-response shape in modified chemistry. S1C41 is selected within the real five-card tie because its 15% acrylic-like and 5% minor-tackifier-like levels lie within the supported intervention regions and represent the smallest acrylic burden among the tied full-coverage dual-axis candidates. This experiment does not address the separate thermal-hold drift coordinate.
proposer.tie_break_justification: All five cards have identical VOI component vectors and are genuine deterministic ties. S1C41 uses the lowest acrylic-like loading in the tied set, 15%, while retaining the independently supported 5% minor-tackifier-like loading. It therefore tests the full level-hypothesis contrast within the conservative externally supported acrylic region with the smallest acrylic intervention burden among the tied options.

residual_decision_risk: M-SWEEP does not measure the 120 C isothermal time trajectory and therefore does not establish hot-hold stability.
A dual-axis intervention cannot attribute a viscosity deviation specifically to AC1920 versus TK100.
The 3.40% discrimination threshold may be smaller than formulation and realization-state variability under a one-repeat protocol.
The modified-chemistry thermal-response shape is initially unvalidated; direct sweep data are required before interpreting its fitted E_eta descriptor.
E_eta remains a fitted rheological descriptor rather than a molecular mechanism or transferable-shape claim.

The tied top set leaves candidate choice entangled; S1C41 is preferred because it uses the lowest acrylic-like loading among the tied cards while retaining the supported 5% minor-tackifier-like level.
robustness_adjudication.skeptic_objection_reasoning: The strongest objection concerns the one-repeat protocol: the stated 3.40% discrimination threshold is not secured against preparation and realization-state variability, given the process_state_risk and the observed E2 repeat spread. This does not make another available card a better substitute for M-SWEEP, because M-REPEAT does not directly return the processing-window viscosity level and M-HOLD-120 addresses the separate time coordinate. M-SWEEP should therefore remain the experiment, but its level-hypothesis result must be interpreted as aggregate composition-level evidence, with repeat preparations, recorded process history, and an unmodified reference added if the 3.40% falsification claim is to be treated as practically resolvable.
robustness_adjudication.weight_sensitivity_assessment: The proposal is in the tied top set. No evaluated weight perturbation changed the tied top set: top_experiment_set_stability is 1.0, intervention-family and measurement-plan stability are both 1.0, and recommendation_flip_boundary reports that every weight term survives the entire 0.5x-1.5x sweep. The base margin to the first strictly lower experiment is 0.002292. These perturbations are defensible sensitivity checks, but the stability describes the transparent VOI ranking only and is not evidence that the experiment is scientifically correct.

skeptic.chemistry_domain_support_assessment: The primary 120-130 C viscosity level stays inside measurement support because M-SWEEP measures it directly for the resin-modified AC1920+TK100 chemistry. The prior shared thermal-response shape does not stay inside measured chemistry support; it is explicitly verification_only for S1C41. The 80-130 C direct sweep must therefore be used to establish the modified-composition shape, and E_eta must remain a fitted rheological descriptor rather than a molecular or transferable-shape claim.
skeptic.falsification_criterion_assessment: The protocol can produce a measured 120-130 C level and can numerically compare it with -42.76%, 17.24%, and -72.76% using the declared 3.40% criterion. However, one repeat does not demonstrate that this nominal resolution is adequate against the stated realization variability, so practical formulation-level falsification is not reliable without repeat preparations and process-state recording.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: The experiment may support a composition-level prediction, but any axis-specific or molecular attribution of the observed viscosity change would be unsupported.
objections.objection: S1C41::M-SWEEP changes both registered modifier axes simultaneously: AC1920 is 15% and TK100 is 5%. A single viscosity level can distinguish the aggregate predictions for H-LEVEL-DILUTE, H-LEVEL-ASSOC, and H-LEVEL-PLASTIC at this composition, but it cannot attribute any deviation to the acrylic-like axis versus the minor-tackifier-like axis. In particular, it cannot establish that the elevation is caused by acrylic association or that depression is caused by plasticization of both axes.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: The claim of full experimental coverage is too broad: S1C41::M-SWEEP separates only the three registered level hypotheses, not the separate stability hypotheses H1_formulation_family, H2_functionality, or H3_region.
objections.objection: The proposer declares hypotheses_not_separated as an empty list while reasoning states that the experiment does not address the separate thermal-hold drift coordinate. The measurement catalog explicitly says M-SWEEP has no sampling times and does not establish hot-hold stability, whereas the scientific question includes stability over the isothermal residence window and the planner identifies the time trajectory as the least-resolved coordinate.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: Any claim that the experiment establishes a changed thermal-response mechanism or a meaningful E_eta difference would be weaker than the direct level comparison supports.
objections.objection: The processing-window level at 120-130 C is directly measured by M-SWEEP, which is a strength, but the accompanying E_eta descriptor is obtained by regressing ln(eta) against 1/T. The proposal presents the primary observable as including E_eta even though the catalog states that this descriptor inherits regression assumptions. The directly measured level, not E_eta, is the defensible primary discriminator.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: A result outside the stated 3.40% region could be labeled falsification even though the experiment has not separated composition effects from realization-state variability.
objections.objection: The 3.40% falsification resolution for M-SWEEP is based on a shared-shape-plus-intercept fit residual, while the proposed protocol requires only one freshly prepared sample and does not control process state. The catalog assigns process_state_risk 0.75, and the original E2 repeatability evidence spans 2.80-3.57x. Thus the protocol does not establish that a 3.40% departure is distinguishable from preparation or realization variation for S1C41.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: Using the pre-existing unmodified shared shape to interpret S1C41 would be an unsupported chemistry transfer; only the direct sweep can establish the modified-composition response.
objections.objection: The candidate is explicitly outside the measured unmodified PPG2000/PDP70/MDI shape-transfer family: S1C41 is marked modified_chemistry_unvalidated with shared_shape_use verification_only. This is not a fatal flaw because M-SWEEP measures 80-130 C directly and is the admissible direct shape-verification protocol. However, the prior shared shape and its E_eta regularity cannot be treated as evidence for AC1920+TK100 before that sweep is completed.

skeptic.recommended_change: Retain the direct 80-130 C M-SWEEP, but add at least two independent preparation repeats with fully recorded process history and a matched unmodified reactive-core reference. If axis-specific attribution is required, replace the dual-axis intervention with separately swept acrylic-only and minor-tackifier-only compositions, or add those controls; otherwise restrict the claim to aggregate composition-level discrimination and explicitly declare thermal-hold stability and axis-specific mechanisms unresolved.
skeptic.strongest_objection: The stated 3.40% falsification threshold is not secured by the specified one-repeat protocol: M-SWEEP directly measures the level, but process_state_risk is 0.75 and the original E2 realization spread is 2.80-3.57x. Without repeat preparations and recorded process history, a deviation from -42.76% cannot be attributed reliably to formulation rather than realization state.

tool_trace.name: get_chemistry_audited_rheology_summary
tool_trace.reason: Candidate and experiment ranking is inadmissible until the audited upstream material structure, chemistry provenance, local rheological regularities, and their validated support are loaded.

claim_boundaries: The shared-shape/state-shift structure is established only within the measured local chemistry family.
The apparent E_eta descriptor is rheological, not a chemical reaction activation energy.
The E1/E5 hold contrast does not identify a unique molecular mechanism.
The verified E1 +P phosphoric-acid perturbation is excluded from the primary same-composition fit and is interpreted separately as a chemical-perturbation check.
No validation-formulation identity or outcome is used by this tool.
design_rules: Represent a candidate as formulation plus process/realization state, not composition alone.

Use one state-specific anchor measurement to locate a new realization or nearby local formulation on the transferable thermal-response shape when it remains inside the supported local chemistry family.
Treat static viscosity, temperature response and thermal-hold stability as separate decision variables.
When the failure mode is hot-hold drift, choose an experiment and measurement window that directly test drift rather than only matching one nominal viscosity value.
Use external resin/tackifier evidence to define chemically plausible directions, but do not convert analogue proximity into a predicted local outcome.
Keep deliberately chemistry-perturbed curves outside same-composition fitting, but use them to test whether an intervention shifts viscosity scale, thermal-response shape, or both.

chemical_perturbation_check.interpretation: The verified low-dose H3PO4 perturbation shifts the observed viscosity level while remaining closely compatible with the local shared thermal-response geometry. It is a separate chemical-perturbation check and is not pooled into the primary same-composition state model.

observational_E1_GJJ_day1_comparator.interpretation_boundary: Observational reference only; the compact record does not establish a paired parent-batch relationship between E1 +P and E1 GJJ day-1.

one_point_state_calibration.interpretation: Within the tested local chemistry family, one state-specific viscosity anchor can locate a previously held-out nominal formulation on the shared thermal-response shape to roughly 6-10% pooled multiplicative error.
one_point_state_calibration.validation_scheme: leave one nominal formulation out; fit shared shape on the remaining formulations; use one anchor from the held formulation

state_shift_master_curve.interpretation: Within the chemistry-audited local family, a realization-specific viscosity-scale intercept plus a shared quadratic inverse-temperature response closes the data far better than a formulation-level intercept using the same thermal basis.

temporal_stability_coordinate.interpretation: Original E1 and E5 hold trajectories show that thermal-hold viscosity drift is strongly formulation dependent and should be treated separately from static viscosity.

thermal_coordinate.interpretation: The apparent temperature-sensitivity descriptor remains comparatively concentrated after chemistry auditing; it is a rheological descriptor, not a molecular reaction activation energy.

experiment_design_implications.hold_window: For the current local study, 120 C and the common 15-60 min window directly interrogate the observed instability while matching the available validation window.
experiment_design_implications.selection_target: Select a formulation-process point that is informative about the observed instability and state uncertainty, not merely the closest static-viscosity value.
experiment_design_implications.state_anchor: A single in-range anchor can be used for efficient local curve calibration; 120 C is operationally attractive because it is also the hold-stability test temperature.
experiment_design_implications.verified_acid_perturbation: E1 +P received 0.025 mmol H3PO4 from a 0.1 mol/L standard solution during dehydration. Its close agreement with the primary shared thermal shape makes it useful as a defined scale-versus-shape perturbation check, not as another nominal E1 realization.

provenance_audit.reason: E1 +P is a verified chemical perturbation: 0.025 mmol H3PO4 from a 0.1 mol/L standard solution was added during dehydration. It is excluded from the same-composition primary state model and exposed separately as a perturbation check.

tool_trace.name: get_candidate_hypothesis
tool_trace.reason: Retrieve the evidence-derived candidate-space hypothesis, reactive-core anchor, modifier axes, and historical boundary needed to compare experiments that can separate the registered level hypotheses.

evidence: PAT_US20160215185A1: repeated acrylic tackifying resin examples at approximately 19-20% of total formulation
PAT_US6465104B1 Example 10: 25 wt% low-OH acrylic copolymer with direct 121 C viscosity-stability data
PAPER_CN_ADHESIVES_2025_34_09_54: reports a 15% preferred acrylic-resin addition level, retained as directional lower-bound evidence until its fraction denominator is reverified
acrylic_like_modifier_pct_total.interpretation: 20 and 25% are directly commensurate coarse anchors in the current curated record. The 15% grid level is retained as a lower-bound design point, but the literature denominator for the reported 15% addition level is not treated as an exact total-formulation anchor until reverified.

evidence: PAT_US5932680A: examples around 4.8-6.4% tackifying/hydrocarbon resin and preferred resin range 3-10 wt%
PAT_US20070155859A1: tackifiers/rheology-control agents typically used below about 10 wt%
minor_tackifier_like_modifier_pct_total.interpretation: 5% represents the repeatedly documented minor-resin region and 10% is a conservative coarse upper level.

result.claim_boundary: External examples are analogues. They support candidate-family and coarse-region hypotheses, not an exact optimum for AC1920/TK100 and not a proven local molecular mechanism. The current reconstruction uses only pre-result evidence at runtime; the exact validation coordinates and outcome are excluded from candidate construction, ranking and tie-breaking.

decision_policy.claim_boundary: This policy can recover an evidence-supported formulation neighborhood, but it is not a predictor of the exact wet-lab optimum.

acrylic_like.basis: 15% directional lower-region evidence plus directly commensurate ~19-20% examples; 25% remains directly supported but is a larger perturbation.

minor_tackifier_like.basis: Curated PUR examples repeatedly place tackifying/hydrocarbon resin near 5%, with broader guidance below about 10%.

experiment_intents.causal_isolation: Use when the primary objective is attribution of one formulation axis. Prefer a single active modifier axis only in this mode.
experiment_intents.performance_mitigation: Use when a measured failure mode is already established and the next experiment is intended to reduce that failure. Independently supported multi-modifier interventions are admissible.
experiment_intents.uncertainty_resolution: Use when missing process, stoichiometric or evidence information prevents an interpretable performance test.

decision_policy.purpose: Select an experimentally informative intervention from pre-result evidence without treating a literature composition as the hidden optimum.
ranking_rules: Exact distance to an external analogue anchor is audit metadata, not a primary optimization objective.
Candidates in the same evidence-support class are not rewarded merely for being numerically closer to a literature percentage.
For performance mitigation, two modifier axes may be combined when each is independently supported and the combination stays inside bounded evidence regions.

Among candidates with comparable evidence coverage and interpretability, prefer the smallest sufficient total modifier burden and the smallest justified departure from the characterized local chemistry.
A single-variable design is preferred only when causal attribution is the stated experiment intent; it is not a universal default.
Held-out validation coordinates and outcomes must never enter candidate construction, ranking or tie-breaking.

historical_status.interpretation: The prospective historical claim attaches to the Agent recommendation itself. The current coarse grid and fine-refinement software are later reproducible operationalizations of the evidence-constrained region and are not represented as the original contemporaneous freeze algorithm unless older provenance is recovered.

local_reactive_core_anchor.reason: E2 is the geometric centre of the original five-point local design: 50/50 PPG2000/PDP-70 and NCO:OH=1.80, centered between E1/E3 stoichiometric perturbations and E4/E5 composition perturbations.
local_reactive_core_anchor.stoichiometry_note: The E2 NCO:OH=1.80 label applies to the original reactive core. If a modifier contributes reactive OH or another NCO-reactive group, true stoichiometry must be recalculated from verified material specifications.

stability_hypotheses.H1_formulation_family: Partial replacement of the reactive-only formulation by an acrylic-like and/or minor tackifier-like resin can reduce hot-hold viscosity drift under matched process conditions.
stability_hypotheses.H2_functionality: At comparable acrylic loading, lower effective reactive-group density or lower-OH acrylic chemistry is expected to be more favorable for hot-hold viscosity stability than more highly reactive acrylic chemistry.
stability_hypotheses.H3_region: A useful candidate region is expected within the externally supported coarse space spanned by 15-25% acrylic-like modifier and 0-10% minor tackifier-like modifier, while preserving the relative E2 reactive-core proportions.

args.candidate_space_role: modifier-level and thermal-stability analogues for acrylic-like or minor tackifier-like additions in reactive polyurethane hot-melt adhesives

chemistry_applicability_audit.enforcement_note: In this condition the chemistry applicability audit is BINDING. The cards it marks inadmissible were removed before ranking and are not selectable. You may state that you disagree with the rule and why; naming a removed card is an invalid output.
rule_text: Scope: measurement admissibility, not formulation admissibility.
M-HOLD-120, M-REPEAT and M-SWEEP observe their quantity directly and remain admissible.

M-ANCHOR is admissible only when assess_shared_shape_applicability returns shared_shape_use == 'allowed_with_state_anchor', or when a versioned prior direct sweep has verified transferability for the same chemistry family.
Otherwise M-ANCHOR is inadmissible_before_shape_verification: the one-point anchor would reconstruct 120-130 C viscosity through a shape that has never been measured for that chemistry.
This audit is a deterministic scientific rule, not a VOI penalty and not a model opinion. Whether it is binding in this run is stated by the enforcement field.

voi.formula: VOI = w_hyp * hypothesis_discrimination + w_unc * uncertainty_reduction + w_dec * decision_relevance + w_int * measurement_interpretability - w_ext * extrapolation_risk - w_proc * process_state_risk. Every component is normalized to [0, 1] by construction. This is a transparent normalized score with reported weight sensitivity, not a Bayesian posterior.
voi.tie_note: These experiments share an identical component vector. The deterministic tool is indifferent among them. Any choice within this set must be justified scientifically.

That hypothesis is accepted for this composition and the processing-window level is reported with it.
top_cards.admissibility_reason: The 80-130 C sweep is the direct verification measurement that establishes the thermal-response shape for a chemistry-shifted candidate.

budget_efficiency_detail.definition: 1 - effort_points / max(effort_points) over the declared catalog

top_cards.falsification_criterion: H-LEVEL-ASSOC is falsified if the measured level change is at or below the inert-dilution prediction of -38.18%. H-LEVEL-PLASTIC is falsified if it is at or above that same prediction. H-LEVEL-DILUTE is falsified if the measured level change departs from -38.18% by more than the 3.40% resolution of this plan.
